info.name: Configuration Files (Forge Config API Port)
info.description: Adds a configuration file element backed by the native Configuration API on Forge 1.16.5 to 1.20.1 and on NeoForge 1.20.1 to 1.21.8. NeoForge 1.20.4 and newer use ModConfigSpec; NeoForge 1.20.1 uses the legacy ForgeConfigSpec. Fabric 1.21.8 uses Forge Config API Port. Element, field and template names are identical to the Configuration Files plugin it ports.
info.author: LitQA
info.credits: Element definitions and user interface based on the Configuration Files plugin by NerdyPuzzle
